speaker: President Timothy L. Farnes
title: Divine Appointments
session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: President Timothy L. Farnes spoke about “Divine Appointments”.

quotes.text: Those words have stayed with me ever since. That is what we do. As covenant followers of Jesus Christ, we minister with compassion to whomever God places in our path. We do it because that’s what the Savior did. And we’ve made a covenant to follow Him.
quotes.speaker: President Timothy L. Farnes
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Each Sabbath day, when you and I partake of the sacrament, we witness to our Father in Heaven our willingness to take upon ourselves the name of His Son, Jesus Christ. That means we choose to see as He sees, feel as He feels, and do as He would do. His life should be reflected in ours. It means that when someone encounters us, they should experience something of Jesus Christ—His kindness, His patience, His hope, His love, His compassion.
quotes.speaker: President Timothy L. Farnes
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Our promise of willingness is met by the Lord’s promise that we can always have His Spirit with us. With that gift, we can minister as the Savior would, with His power and His loving kindness.
quotes.speaker: President Timothy L. Farnes
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: We make the covenant during sacred time with God every Sunday. A way we keep the covenant is by ministering to God’s children every day. Often this happens when God places someone in our path and we have eyes to see them. I call these “divine appointments.”
quotes.speaker: President Timothy L. Farnes
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: When Jesus was asked, “What shall I do to inherit eternal life?” He answered with a story about a man who had eyes to see. In the story, a traveler lay wounded on the road to Jericho. Where others saw an inconvenience or an interruption, one man saw an opportunity to minister—a divine appointment. Seeing awakened compassion. Compassion moved him to act. And his actions changed a life forever.
quotes.speaker: President Timothy L. Farnes
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: This pattern defined the Savior’s ministry. He turned ordinary encounters with people into extraordinary moments of healing, encouragement, and transformation. To Jesus, these people were not interrupting His mission. They were His mission.
quotes.speaker: President Timothy L. Farnes
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: God has given us eyes to see. When we use them, we begin to recognize divine appointments all around us. What once looked like random encounters become invitations from the Lord to minister with compassion.
quotes.speaker: President Timothy L. Farnes
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: In broken, timid English, he explained that he was on the way to his mission, it was going to be his first time on an airplane alone, and he was terrified. I learned he was a long way from his home country and he was holding the alarm clock to make sure he didn’t miss the plane.
quotes.speaker: President Timothy L. Farnes
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference
